strings.AZW_idea_saharan_nomads_desc: The Sahara is a brutal environment, where only the hardiest forms of life can survive. The Tuareg tribes of Azawad are masters of this hostile landscape, making as much of a home of it as anyone could. Centuries of passed-down experience have given them a greater understanding of the desert than any outsider could ever hope to attain.
strings.AZW_idea_tuareg_heritage_desc: Azawad is not a nation so much as it is a tribal confederation, an alliance of the Tuareg tribes of the southwestern Sahara. The government isn't decentralized, it simply doesn't exist. Individual tribes roam the desert, migrating across the sands as they have done for centuries. Without significant reform and centralization, Azawad will never be remembered as anything other than a temporarily unclaimed region of western Africa.
